name: On-screen keyboard (v3, Velum)
author: Henri Schulz
description: Velum's on-screen keyboard for the tablet's cast screen: German keys as on an iPad, opened from the window bar (cast screen, tablet mode) or the menu-bar keyboard on a machine with a touchscreen; keys go through fcitx5's virtual keyboard mode (bridge/velum-osk), a real key closes it.

barWidget.description: Keyboard glyph that toggles the on-screen keyboard; only where a hardware touchscreen exists
